name: LJ RaceLab
mission: I'm building a record of real engineering — designing parts, printing them, breaking them on purpose, measuring what happened, and working out what to change. By the time I apply to university I want to show five years of documented work, not five years of enthusiasm.
intro: I'm 13, I live near Charlotte, and I want to be a Formula 1 engineer. This site is the logbook: every project, every failure, every number.
